info.title: wavespeed/seedvr2
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "wavespeed/seedvr2", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for WavespeedAI image upscaling. One component serves both wavespeed/seedvr2 and wavespeed/ultimate-image-upscaler, which take the same request shape.

enable_base64_output.description: If enabled, the output will be encoded into a BASE64 string instead of a URL.

image.description: The URL of the image to upscale.

output_format.description: The format of the output image.

target_resolution.description: The target resolution of the output image.

200.description: OK - the provider's native result document, returned unchanged. Comfy has not described this model's output yet, so neither its shape nor its media type is narrowed here; the provider's own documentation is authoritative.

schema.description: Comfy has not described this model's result document yet. Router returns the provider's native output unchanged, so the provider's own documentation is authoritative for the response shape.
